assets.name: castle-red
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game art matching a medieval illuminated manuscript: consistent thin dark umber ink outlines, simplified charming medieval forms, flat hand-painted gouache, faded vermilion, indigo, ochre, sage, ivory, delicate sparse hatching and very subtle pigment wear. Beautiful coherent illustrated parchment strategy game, NOT realistic, NOT 3D, NOT modern metallic UI, no glossy gradients. Genuine transparent background outside each object, no checkerboard baked in, no watermark, no labels or text. Objects fully visible, generous transparent padding. One isolated tall medieval castle gate complex for the LEFT edge of a horizontal battlefield, three-quarter manuscript view with gate facing slightly RIGHT toward field. Broad arched wooden entrance at lower center, two crenellated stone towers, red conical roofs, red hanging banners with simple gold lion heraldry, tiny ivy accents at base. Ochre limestone, light simplified ink masonry, stylized flat medieval perspective. One complete building, roughly portrait 3:4 silhouette, no ground rectangle, scenery, units, people or background. Same line detail scale throughout. Readable at game size, not excessively intricate.

assets.name: ui-kit
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game art matching a medieval illuminated manuscript: consistent thin dark umber ink outlines, simplified charming medieval forms, flat hand-painted gouache, faded vermilion, indigo, ochre, sage, ivory, delicate sparse hatching and very subtle pigment wear. Beautiful coherent illustrated parchment strategy game, NOT realistic, NOT 3D, NOT modern metallic UI, no glossy gradients. Genuine transparent background outside each object, no checkerboard baked in, no watermark, no labels or text. Objects fully visible, generous transparent padding. A neatly organized game UI COMPONENT ATLAS, landscape canvas, individual separated objects in a regular grid, at least 40 pixels clear transparent spacing, no touching. Twelve usable components in EXACTLY three rows of four slots, not a complete screenshot. ROW 1: empty tall ivory parchment unit card frame with ink vine corners; second matching empty card frame with gold selected border; circular portrait frame with transparent empty center and small red ribbon; matching circular portrait frame with transparent empty center and blue ribbon. ROW 2: long slim EMPTY horizontal health bar frame with transparent center; long slim RED flat painted health fill strip with no frame; matching BLUE fill strip with no frame; compact ornate circular clock frame with ivory blank center. ROW 3: wide blank parchment title ribbon; wide blank ivory parchment information panel with modest illustrated vine border; small square parchment button with ink border; small gold corner-bracket selection frame with fully transparent interior. No portraits, symbols inside buttons, lettering, numbers, actual units or cards with art. Each component is independent and cleanly extractable. Papery interiors only where specified, empty frame centers transparent. All decoration subordinate to usability.
